# Generate output grid from the observed rule: join diagonal 1s; for any 6 on that segment, draw the opposite-slope 6 diagonal to the edges.
R,C=19,16
g=[[4]*C for _ in range(R)]
ones=[(2,2),(4,14),(10,10),(17,9)]
sixes=[(4,4),(6,6),(7,14),(15,2)]
for r,c in ones:g[r][c]=1
for r,c in sixes:g[r][c]=6
# diagonal aligned pair (2,2) to (10,10)
for i in range(9):g[2+i][2+i]=1
# perpendicular full diagonals through 6s on connector
for r,c in [(4,4),(6,6)]:
    for rr in range(R):
        cc=r+c-rr
        if 0<=cc<C and g[rr][cc]!=1: g[rr][cc]=6
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
